about_the_game:
The Only Card Game Where You Can Collect, Battle, and Trade… Everything.

Ever wondered who’d win in a fight, Loki or a pug? T-Rex vs Houdini? Napoleon or the Sphinx? In Cards, the Universe and Everything (CUE), these deeply important questions are finally answered. Collect the best of history, science, myths, nature and much more…

No paywalls, just good old-fashioned wheeling and dealing with players across the world. Build your dream collection, track down and exchange rare cards, or hoard 37 copies of a Honey Badger just for the hell of it.

With over 5,000 cards spanning everything from black holes to Black Hawks, you can build decks that are brilliant, bizarre, or just plain unfair. In case you're wondering, that's more than 434 quintillion possible card combinations per round, so things never get boring.
Sure, Space, History and Science might sound like a school project, but really, it’s mostly shouting as Henry VIII flattens your quantum physicist and the angry goose you just played ruins everything. Each arena has its own twists, and every card is packed with curious facts to make defeat feel oddly enlightening.

Win trophies, unlock powerful new cards, and collect rewards in regular events. Because who doesn’t love being rewarded for playing cards?



Craft Special Cards and Fuse Duplicates

Uncover secret recipes, combine duplicates, and create new cards with game-changing abilities. Or just melt down your spares in a blind panic after a crushing defeat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2120 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Cards, the Universe and Everything is a unique trading card game with almost limitless possibilities: Dinosaurs, Norse gods, blue-footed boobies, Samurai, volcanoes, even the god particle. With the universe’s thingamabobs and endless strategies, are you ready for this gloriously bonkers game?
